## 跨服对照应记录什么

- 逐项记录游戏名称、发行地区、公告 URL、公告日期与对应客户端版本，不要只写“官网确认”。
- 把语言、平台、账号互通、角色数值和赛季安排分开查证；同名角色也不能自动共用技能或种族值。
- 将已实装、测试中、产品建议和待核实分栏；上线后若干天的规划只能作为编辑建议，不能写成承诺。

## 如何推进后续资料

先获得可复核的国际服证据，再建立适用范围；没有依据的字段保持待核实，不从国服补值。
contentEn:
## What to record when comparing regions

- Record the game identity, release region, announcement URL, publication date and client version separately. “Officially confirmed” without a reproducible citation is insufficient.
- Verify languages, platforms, account sharing, character values and seasons independently. A matching character name does not establish identical skills or base stats.
- Separate implemented features, tests, editorial proposals and unknowns. Plans for the first weeks after a launch are suggestions, not delivery commitments.

## How to expand the reference

Obtain reproducible global evidence before setting its scope. Leave unsupported fields unverified rather than filling them from CN data.

- 実装済み、テスト中、編集上の提案、未確認を区分してください。配信後の運営案は提案であり、実施の約束ではありません。

## 今後の資料整備

再確認できる国際版の根拠を得てから適用範囲を定めます。不明な項目を中国版の値で埋めないでください。

content:
## 报名之前先确认

- 核对公告是否属于正确游戏、区服和测试批次，保存原始 URL 与发布日期。旧 Steam 引用对应其他游戏，不能作为报名依据。

## 资格与后续安排

contentEn:
## Before attempting signup

- Match the announcement to the correct game, region and test batch. Preserve its original URL and publication date. The old Steam citation identifies another game and cannot establish signup rules.
- Check the signup window, time zone, eligibility distribution and platforms separately. Pre-registration is not itself proof of beta access.
- Do not submit identity documents, pay or install clients based on the older guide. Referral links also need a verified issuer and event scope.

## Eligibility and next steps

Publish a definite schedule only after obtaining reproducible evidence. Verify eligibility messages and download destinations separately; leave missing information unverified.

content:
## 选择建议需要哪些证据

- 先核对当前国际服版本是否有初始选择，以及具体可选对象。本站保留的名字和六条导航记录不能证明官方名单或数量。
- 分别验证属性、数值、资质、技能、进化与后续获取条件；国服同名或相似形象不代表规则相同。
- 比较培养成本、关卡环境与可重复实测后再给建议。未知表现不能自动排成 A 级或当作零值。

## 在核实之前

不要按旧“稳定续航、快速开荒、随时补抓”说法投入资源。缺乏依据不证明这些对象或机制不存在。
contentEn:
## Evidence needed for a recommendation

- Verify whether the relevant global version has a starter choice and which options it offers. Legacy names and six navigation records cannot establish an official list or total.
- Check types, values, aptitude, skills, evolution and later acquisition separately. CN names or similar artwork do not establish identical rules.
- Compare investment costs, content conditions and reproducible play tests before recommending a choice. Unknown performance must not default to A or zero.

## Before verification

Do not invest based on the old sustain, fast-start or catch-later promises. Missing support does not prove the creatures or mechanics do not exist.

content:
## 先建立产品身份

- 先确认游戏名称、开发或发行主体、地区版本和公告出处；不要以商店链接的名称尾缀代替 App ID 身份。

## 了解玩法的可靠顺序

先核对实际适用版本与客户端，再整理有依据的玩法条目。本文不承诺首发数量、免费游玩或特定平台支持。

## Establish the product identity first

- Check the game name, developer or publisher, region and announcement source. A name appended to a store URL does not replace App ID identity verification.
- Creature names, counts, acquisition methods and battle rules each need reproducible support. A trailer is not a complete feature list or proof of implementation in every region.
- Separate solo play, multiplayer, test experience and release rules. Similar games and CN experience do not establish global settings.

## A reliable order for learning about gameplay

Verify the applicable version and client before documenting supported mechanics. This page promises no launch roster size, free-to-play terms or platform support.

## 按平台分别检查

- 确认对应区服、操作系统、设备要求、商店发行主体与 App ID；一个平台的公告不自动覆盖其他平台。
- 区分商店愿望单、预注册、测试资格、预下载和正式可玩状态，不把“有页面”写成“可下载游玩”。
- 不要使用旧错误 Steam 链接、第三方安装包或付费售卖资格的链接。先核验来源，再判断是否需要下载。

对照官方来源中的版本、发布日期和完整下载域名；不能核实就停止安装，不以本文代替安全认证。
contentEn:
## Check each platform separately

- Match the region, operating system, device requirements, store publisher and App ID. An announcement for one platform does not automatically cover others.
- Distinguish wishlists, pre-registration, beta eligibility, preloads and playable release status. A store page is not proof that a client is available to play.
- Do not use the old wrong-game Steam link, third-party packages or paid access offers. Verify the issuer before deciding whether to download.

## The final check before downloading

Compare version, publication date and complete download domain with a reproducible official source. Stop installation when verification is missing; this page is not a security certification.

## 重建战斗资料的条件

- 记录客户端版本、区服、玩法与证据来源，把预告展示、测试实测和正式规则分开。
- 技能数量、行动顺序、体力消耗与恢复、换人、属性克制和提示界面需逐项验证，不能从国服照搬。

contentEn:
## Conditions for rebuilding battle information

- Record client version, region, mode and evidence source. Distinguish trailer demonstrations, beta observations and release rules.
- Verify skill counts, action order, stamina costs and recovery, switching, type interactions and interface hints individually rather than copying CN rules.
- Competitive matchmaking, level or gear adjustments need mode-specific rules and reproducible tests. Unknown values are not zero, and one case does not establish every mode.

## Testing and publication limits

Verify conditions before publishing versioned advice. Old rankings and circular citations between our guides cannot replace missing global evidence.

- 分别核对预约活动的适用区服、时间、参与条件、奖励内容和领取渠道。不要把其他地区的福利迁移过来。

- Verify the promotion region, dates, entry conditions, rewards and claim channel independently. Do not transfer another region’s benefits to the global release.
- Check whether a questionnaire, invitation or selection step is required against the actual rules. Repetition between our older guides is not independent evidence.
- Verify progress wipes and reward carryover, text and voice languages, and payments and refunds separately. General beta conventions cannot establish specific rules.

## Before claiming or sharing information

Keep the complete promotion source and conditions. Do not pay or disclose sensitive data based on an unverified reward promise.

title: 国际服商业模式核验：免费、付费与公平性
titleEn: Global Monetization Verification: Free Access, Payments and Fairness
summary: 旧“确认免费”“无付费优势”“精灵全部免费获取”和测试无内购的结论缺乏本批可独立复核的依据，暂予撤回。未知不等于收费或存在付费优势。
summaryEn: The earlier confirmed-free, no-paid-advantage, all-creatures-free and no-beta-purchases conclusions lack independently reproducible support in this review and are withdrawn. Unknown does not mean paid access or pay-to-win.
content:
## 商业模式需要拆开核验

- 分别确认下载价格、游玩门槛、平台订阅、内购种类、抽取机制与精灵获取方式，不能用一个“免费”概括。
- 核对声明适用的是测试还是正式版、国服还是国际服；测试不开付费也不能证明正式版无内购。
- 公平性需要明确竞技模式、付费道具效果与获取途径；没有证据时不承诺“无 Pay-to-Win”。

## 做消费决定前

以适用地区的价格、协议和退款规则为准，不用未经核实的商业承诺估算长期成本。
contentEn:
## Verify separate parts of the business model

- Check download price, access requirements, platform subscriptions, purchase categories, random acquisition and creature unlock methods independently. A single “free” label cannot cover them all.
- Identify whether a statement covers a beta or release, CN or global. A test without payments would not establish a release without purchases.
- Fairness claims need a defined competitive mode, item effects and acquisition methods. Do not promise no pay-to-win without evidence.

## Before making spending decisions

Use the prices, terms and refund rules for the applicable region. Unverified commercial promises are not a reliable long-term cost estimate.

## 商業モデルを分けて確認

- DL価格、参加条件、機種別の定額契約、内課金の種類、抽選、精霊の入手方法を個別に確認します。「無料」の一語だけでは説明できません。

summaryEn: The old comparison relied on unverified global features, free-access promises, roster counts and test dates. Those conclusions are withdrawn. This page is a comparison method, not a new product review.
content:
## 如何做可复核的对比

- 指定两款作品的具体版本、地区和平台，不把一个系列的全部作品当作单一产品。
- 分别比较价格、单人或联机、战斗、收集和账号进度；每一格附适用范围和来源，没有依据就写待核实。
- 宣传片、媒体试玩和正式客户端证据分层，不把体验片段推广为所有版本的功能承诺。

## 如何做选择

先列自己的预算、设备和游玩方式，再核对双方已确认条件。不要依据旧“免费参加测试”或跨平台承诺决定消费。
contentEn:
## Building a reproducible comparison

- Identify the exact edition, region and platform on each side. A whole franchise is not a single product with one feature set.
- Compare pricing, solo or multiplayer access, battles, collection and account progress separately. Give each cell a source and scope; mark unsupported cells unverified.
- Keep trailers, press hands-ons and release-client evidence distinct. A short demonstration does not promise the same features in every version.

## Making a choice

List your budget, device and preferred play style, then verify both products against those needs. Do not spend based on the old free-beta or cross-platform promises.

title: 国际服跨平台信息核验：联机与进度互通
titleEn: Global Cross-platform Verification: Play and Progression
summary: 旧“首日全平台联机”、平台矩阵和进度共享的确定承诺暂予撤回。本文区分跨平台联机、跨平台进度与测试资格，不证明这些功能已实装。
summaryEn: Earlier promises of day-one all-platform play, the platform matrix and shared progression are withdrawn. This page distinguishes crossplay, cross-progression and beta access; it does not prove implementation.
content:
## 互通需要分别回答的问题

- 跨平台联机指不同设备是否能在同一会话游玩；跨平台进度指账号进度能否在设备间继续，两者不能互相替代。
- 按设备组合、地区服务器和游戏版本查证，确认是否有联机限制、邀请条件或测试资格要求。
- 购买权益、账号绑定与存档继承需要单独的条款，不从“支持跨平台”四字推导全部互通。

## 与朋友一起游玩前

逐人确认设备、地区与资格，再按可复核公告核对功能。不要按旧平台矩阵购买设备或安装客户端。
contentEn:
## Questions that need separate answers

- Crossplay concerns whether different devices can join the same session. Cross-progression concerns continuing account progress across devices. Neither implies the other.
- Verify each device pairing, region server and game version, including session restrictions, invitations and test eligibility.
- Purchases, account linking and save carryover require separate terms. A cross-platform label cannot establish all forms of sharing.

## Before planning with friends

Check each player’s device, region and access, then verify the feature against a reproducible announcement. Do not buy hardware or install clients based on the old matrix.
